# Research Roadmap

## Current Stage

Exploratory framing and synthesis across agent learning theories.

## Milestones

### Phase 1 — Concept Formation
- Clarify core terms (model failure, learning trigger, improvement target)
- Consolidate initial research questions
- Align with relevant literature traditions

### Phase 2 — Mechanism Design
- Draft candidate internal learning-trigger mechanisms
- Compare mechanism alternatives and assumptions
- Define evaluation criteria

### Phase 3 — Prototype Experiments
- Design small conceptual/behavioral simulations
- Run controlled toy experiments
- Document observations and failure modes

### Phase 4 — Refinement
- Incorporate supervisor feedback
- Prioritize the strongest direction
- Translate insights into a focused project plan

## High-Level Flow

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  A[Framing Questions] --> B[Literature Mapping]
  B --> C[Mechanism Proposals]
  C --> D[Toy Experiments]
  D --> E[Analysis]
  E --> F[Refinement]
  F --> C
```
